headline: UK to fund AI Biosecurity Lab to detect threats and aid vaccines
summary: The UK is investing in a new AI Biosecurity Lab, to be unveiled by the chancellor as part of Wednesday's Budget, that will help detect biological threats and develop vaccines using AI.

claims.statement: The UK is investing in a new AI Biosecurity Lab.

sources.quote: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab
The UK is investing $134 million into an AI Biosecurity Lab

claims.statement: The lab will help detect biological threats and develop vaccines using AI.
